signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Username and password. That is all we ask for.

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.subtitle: Pick a username and a password. No email, no verification code, no waiting.

rules.username: {{min}}–{{max}} characters. Letters, numbers, dot, dash and underscore; must start with a letter.
rules.noEmail: We never ask for an email address, so there is no way to send you a reset link. Keep your password somewhere safe.

error.notConfigured: Accounts are switched off on this installation — no database is connected. Everything still works; your data stays in this browser.
error.invalidCredentials: That username and password do not match an account.
error.usernameTaken: That username is already taken. Try another one.
error.usernameInvalid: That username does not follow the rules below.
error.passwordMismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
error.needsConfirmation: The server cannot finish creating accounts yet: it needs SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY set, or "Confirm email" turned off in the Supabase project.
error.signupDisabled: New sign-ups are disabled on this project.
error.offline: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

account.title: Account
account.guestHint: An account is optional. Without one, your settings, journal and rules live in this browser only — clearing site data or switching device loses them.
account.signedInHint: Signed in. Your analysis is identical either way; the account exists so your journal and settings can follow you between devices.
account.unavailable: No database is connected on this installation, so accounts are unavailable. Nothing else is affected.

optional: Signing in is optional — every screen works without an account.
